description: Angular component for managing dynamic select items in a form, including validation, drag-and-drop reordering, and integration with Angular forms.

classes.name: DynamicFormSelectItemsComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for dynamic select items management.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: selectItemValueUnique
methods.description: Checks if a select item value is unique among controls.

methods.name: selectItemsFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of select items.

methods.name: removeSelectItem
methods.description: Removes a select item at specified index.

methods.name: addSelectItem
methods.description: Adds a new empty select item.

methods.name: prepareSelectItemsFormArray
methods.description: Prepares form array from list of items.
